# PDF Compressor

> PDF Compressor is a Chrome extension that compresses PDF files to reduce their size. Processing happens locally on the user's device; files are not uploaded to external servers.

## Key facts

- Type: Chrome browser extension
- Processing: Local, in the browser; works offline after installation
- Interface: Drag-and-drop, with batch processing
- Compression: Multiple quality levels, from high quality to extreme compression
- File size: Up to 150MB per file, no monthly limits

## Links

- [Install from the Chrome Web Store](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/pdf-compressor/pmkddnlhkeffkiomeijcancokeichgei): Official install page
- [Guide](https://compressor-pdf.com/guide/): Step-by-step guide to compressing a PDF in Chrome without uploading it
- [FAQ](https://compressor-pdf.com/faq/): Answers to common questions about file size limits, offline use, privacy, and compression levels
- [Local vs. Upload](https://compressor-pdf.com/local-vs-upload/): Comparison of local (in-browser) processing vs. upload-based PDF compressors
